body.condition: Fixed \(\varepsilon>0\) and \(t_\star>0\) satisfy \(\sup_{x:d_a(x)\le t_\star}\pi_a(x)\le1-\varepsilon\) for every \(a\in\mathcal A_{\mathrm H}\).

novel.justification: This local subclass restriction separates each studied zero-propensity endpoint from simultaneous near-deterministic assignment at that same endpoint. Two-sided logistic-odds charts satisfy it on fixed endpoint neighborhoods even when the opposite arm is heavy at the other endpoint.
